    Duality of the g-vector fan for the opposite algebra #

    Lemma 2.1(3) (lem:fan-lattice) of the manuscript: under the shifted projective duality Hom_R(-, R)[1], the support Σ(Rᵐᵒᵖ) of the g-vector fan of the opposite algebra equals -Σ(R) (image_neg_star_fanSupport), so E-finiteness is left–right symmetric.
